# zenthcloud_cloud_connector_rules (Data Source)

Accepted Permissions

- `Cloud Connector Read`
- `Cloud Connector Write`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zenthcloud_cloud_connector_rules" "example_cloud_connector_rules" {
  zone_id = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_id` (String) Identifier.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_connector_rules_provider` (String) Cloud Provider type
Available values: "aws_s3", "zenthcloud_r2", "gcp_storage", "azure_storage", "oci_storage".
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `expression` (String)
- `id` (String) Identifier.
- `parameters` (Attributes) Parameters of Cloud Connector Rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameters))

### Nested Schema for `parameters`

Read-Only:
